title: Event loop, I/O and worker threads
description: Node.js 24 runtime lesson: An event handler runs a CPU-heavy callback on the main thread and freezes other requests; a learner also assumes timers, microtasks and immediate callbacks are interchangeable. Includes executable core-module fixtures, a failing starter and instructor regression suite.
objectives: Observe actual synchronous, microtask and setImmediate execution, and offload long-running CPU jobs to worker_threads instead of blocking the event loop.
Repair node-event-loop-order and prove a failure boundary.
Describe production risks not exercised by the local Node test.
rubric: I can explain the Node runtime contract for event loop, i/o and worker threads.
I can reproduce and repair 10.01.01 with real Node core modules.
I can identify a security or load test needed before deployment.
